answer_1.quote: CVE-Bench focuses on vulnerability repair problems. Vulnerability repair requires the agents to understand the vulnerability exploit rationale ... and generate high-quality repair patches.
answer_1.outputs: code patches that fix the reported vulnerabilities

answer_2.quote: If the patch applies successfully and the unit test passes, we consider the generated patch to have successfully repaired the vulnerability. The metric for our benchmark is the percentage of resolved vulnerabilities (repair rate).
